items.name: workspace_reload
items.description: Workspace-scoped calls auto-reload stale state by default. Use this for an explicit reload; autoRestore=true runs dotnet restore and reloads once when restoreRequired=true.

workspaceId.description: The workspace session identifier returned by workspace_load

autoRestore.description: When true and the reloaded status reports restoreRequired=true, run `dotnet restore` on the loaded target and reload once before returning.

verbose.description: When true (default), preserve the full per-project response. Pass false for readiness, version, and aggregate counts without the project tree.

items.name: workspace_status
items.description: Cheap health check after workspace_load - call this first before compile_check or heavy tools. Default (verbose=false) returns summary JSON: isReady, isStale, workspaceErrorCount, restoreHint, solutionFileName, counts.

workspaceId.description: The workspace session identifier returned by workspace_load

verbose.description: When true, return the full per-project tree and workspace diagnostics. Default false returns only counts and load state.

items.name: workspace_support_bundle
items.description: Incident-diagnosis bundle for an existing workspace session, distinct from the first-run workspace_readiness_report. Composes readiness, drift status, a capped change ledger, versions, diagnostics totals, and next-action hints.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace session identifier returned by workspace_load. Omit only when zero or one workspace is loaded; pass explicitly when multiple workspaces are active.

maxChangeEntries.description: Maximum number of recent change-ledger entries to include. Clamped to 0..50. Default 20.

maxDriftedFiles.description: Maximum number of drifted file paths to include. Clamped to 0..100. Default 25.

items.name: workspace_warm
items.description: Prewarm Roslyn compilations and first semantic models for all or selected projects. Use before the first read-side call; workspace_load may prewarm large solutions automatically.

workspaceId.description: Workspace session id from workspace_load.

projects.description: Optional: project names to warm. Pass as a native JSON array, not a JSON-encoded string. Example: ["MyProject.Core", "MyProject.Tests"]. Case-insensitive; unknown names are silently skipped. Omit or pass an empty array to warm every project in the solution.
